text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
That was a magnificent, brilliant victory.
……Leaving no opening whatsoever!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm sure...
you will find it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
……Man,
this is getting so annoying.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Of course. By the time I face you again,
I will definitely... find the answer.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Until then,
I will eliminate all openings.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
So perfectly, not even a single strand
of hair could slip through.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes. That's exactly why
it's a challenge worth taking on!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"This time for sure, I will return victorious from Hong Kong.
I'll become stronger and defeat you."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Until then...
I leave the title of Japan's strongest in your hands.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Next year, without fail...
Please take on the world.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...To be completely honest, a whole lot of things were tough!
Even so..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: That scenery is—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Because it's something
you definitely need to see.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
“...If you don't hurry,
I'm going to bring it to you first, you know?”

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: To the first glory in Japanese history!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I won't let you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —Leave it to me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the race, Duramente held a press conference.
She was to announce her next start, but—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"—Then, for the next race,
let's go with the Japan Cup."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup is one of the GⅠ races where the nation's
finest Umamusume gather...
Winning here carries tremendous significance.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I want to make the Japan Cup the greatest race possible.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
How can we
grab the attention of the entire nation?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She remains a girl of few words, as always... but
I somehow understood what Duramente wanted to say. If so—
choice_data_list: Just convey those feelings exactly as they are.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—In this year's "Japan Cup",
Japan's strongest will be decided.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Murmur...)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Until now, the Japan Cup has been a stage to show
Japan's strength to the world by inviting
overseas Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: "However, this year, the nation's strongest Umamusume will gather... in other words, it will be the race to decide the strongest in Japan."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
And Japan's strongest Umamusume
becomes the strongest in the world.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"And who is that Umamusume?
Naturally—it is I."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Carrying the title of the strongest from all of you...
I will win the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe next year."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Japan's leading star—
is me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was no tremor in her voice.
Chest held high, staring straight ahead...
Duramente declared war to the whole of Japan.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Holy crap, Duramente...!
She actually said it!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
“Still, with how strong she is...
something truly incredible might happen, don't you think!?”

text_block_list.name: Dura's Fan
text_block_list.text:
"...It will. It definitely will.
I saw it myself."

text_block_list.name: Dura's Fan
text_block_list.text: Duramente is—an Umamusume who will win the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Incredible, you're incredible, Miss Dura...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Let me be a part
of your festival too...!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...All righttt!
Next stop, the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Phone Sound
text_block_list.text: ""Carrying the mantle of everyone's greatest, I will win the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe next year.""

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Duramente is entering
the Japan Cup, too...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: "...What... am I supposed to do...?"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Cheval!
Mom just messaged us—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "...Ah, footage of Duramente. Is that from today's Tenno Sho (Autumn)?"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
!
...T-This is...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...It's not like... I was studying it or anything.
I mean... there's no way I can win anyway.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Even knowing full well you're going to lose...
to still step up to the challenge."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...Ridiculous?
Just like my Triple Tiara run, losing continuously to Gentildonna."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
!
N-No way...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Just kidding. But let me say this:
don't you ever assume you're going to lose.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Even if there's an opponent who is unconditionally strong,
one you just can't seem to beat...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"You just have to keep trying until you win.
Again, and again, and again—"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Even if I end up not winning.
The results of continually challenging myself will remain.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
With that...
I grasped a victory that was entirely my own.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: My very own...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sure my stubborn persistence
has rubbed off on you as well."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise,
you wouldn't be training non-stop like this.
Mom was worried because you hadn't replied, you know?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...!
But can someone like me... really...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Cheval.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, the race will begin.
You will stand at the starting line without fail."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Even if we tremble, whatever happens.
...That's just who we are.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Duramente's press conference was a success.
By now, dignified photos of her should be adorning headlines across all media outlets.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
...It's all thanks to you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"You carried the weight of being the strongest with me that day...
Your words gave me the push I needed."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I found a great Trainer.
...Truly.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Not much time left until the race.
Let's push even harder.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
At the Japan Cup—
I will stand at the very top of Japan.
